positions.description: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Software Design · Engineering · TypeScript · PostgreSQL · Linux · Unix · React.js · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Ruby · Product Development · Site Reliability Engineering · Database Administration · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Telephony · Telemetry · Datadog · Infrastructure · Full-Stack Development · Release Engineering · Node.js · Caddy

positions.title: Software Engineer, Mobile Innovation Lab
positions.description:
- IBM Cloud Application Tools 2 Beta (Local Tools) - Full Stack Dev (https://console.bluemix.net/docs/cli/icat.html#icat)
- IBM Cloud Application Tools (ICAT) - Full Stack Dev (http://cloudtools.bluemix.net).
- SXSW Beer Tasting Experience (Tasting) - Backend Dev (https://www.ibm.com/innovation/milab/work/ibm-sxsw-tasting-experience/).

- Local Tools: Architected and implemented frontend and backend for CLI and associated plugin versioning control using ReactJS and NodeJS.
- Local Tools: Researched and implemented logic for version polling of CLIs and associated plugins.
- Local Tools: Implemented authentication system and maintained parity with Bluemix and CloudFoundry files during login.
- Local Tools: Maintain parity between Bluemix and CloudFoundry files when updating targeted Bluemix Account, Region, Organization, and Space.
- ICAT: Led one release as Scrum Master.
- ICAT: Moved to lead backend developer (NodeJS/Swift).
- ICAT: Offer support and receive feedback from direct users.
- Tasting: Refactored server to use Socket.io direct calls between client devices and the server.
- Tasting: Implemented system for client-side Socket.io calls to server from all client devices.
- Various Projs: Design and implement logging system for users to send when submitting feedback about app.
- Presented and demonstrated Bluemix and some of its offerings to University students.
- Assist Cloud Experience Lab 2017 interns as Dev Mentor.

positions.title: Extreme Blue Technical Intern
positions.description:
- Worked directly with IBM customer-facing team to gather requirements and goals.
- Implemented a RESTful API in Node.js & Express.js with a web-token middleware to be consumed by both mobile and web apps.
- Modeled the DB2 database structure to store customer's data for the RESTful API to send over HTTP requests.
- Helped design polling and scheduling algorithm for gathering customer's data to store in database.
- Aided in setting up the database server that hosted on IBM’s SoftLayer cloud infrastructure.
- Presented to IBM executives.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed a Read-More-Message Controller for the Elections’ Wizard in UltiPro using KnockoutJS.
- Added warning message validation to existing code base within the Elections’ Wizard for UltiPro.
- Wrote integration test cases for the SeleniumWebAdapter and its child classes within Ultimate Software’s automation framework. Included 136 tests to support IE (8, 9, 10, 11+), Firefox (29, 30+), Chrome (33+).
- Worked with Domain Specific Language in its earliest stages to create rules for the users to consume.
- Diagnose, debug, and fix 23 Continuous Integration (CI) environments for the Global Benefits team.
- Train new hires on how to use Ultimate Software's automation framework, as well as the Hudson server to maintain and monitor CI environments.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Lead two discussions periods where students are broken off into smaller groups from the lecture class. During discussions, students are really encouraged to ask questions on the course material and later are expected to take their weekly quiz. 
- Hold weekly office hours for students who would like additional help and to have their questions answered regarding assignments and upcoming projects. 
- Grade assignments, quizzes, and tests, as well as leave constructive comments and advice for future challenges.

projects.title: MeetUp
projects.description: Android app for coordinating groups. Users are allowed to request locations, send pings and messages, and set dates and times of events to members of created groups.

projects.title: SprkShare
projects.description: As part of our semester project in Information System & Databases (CIS4301), four teammates and I worked together using NodeJS, ExpressJS, and KnockoutJS frameworks for client and server side handling. All HTML is rendered via Jade template engine in part with the ExpressJS framework. The Bootstrap 3 framework was used for most of the CSS.
